Subject: [unmarked] ranef() on unmarkedFitPCO object that was fit using dynamics='trend'
Sent by: unma...@googlegroups.com




Hi All

Is it possible to use the ranef() function on an unmarkedFitPCO object that was fit using dynamics='trend'

I get the following:
> m1 <- pcountOpen(~1, ~1, ~1, ~1, umf1, K=30, mixture = 'P', dynamics='constant')
> m2 <- pcountOpen(~1, ~1, ~1, ~1, umf1, K=30, mixture = 'P', dynamics='trend')
> re1 <- ranef(m1)
> re2 <- ranef(m2)
Error in .local(object, ...) :
 omega is not a parameter in the dynamics='trend' model

If not, is there an another option I'm unaware of?
Cheers
Thomas

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] ranef() on unmarkedFitPCO object that was fit using dynamics='trend'
parts:
Hi Thomas,

That would be possible, but it's unlikely that I will have time to implement it any time soon. One option would be to fit the model in the most recent version of JAGS. Note that neither WinBUGS or OpenBUGS can fit the model for some reason, and old versions of JAGS don't work either. Here is so some code that might help: https://sites.google.com/site/unmarkedinfo/home/workshops/patux2012/r-scripts/script-dailMadsen.R?attredirects=0&d=1

Richard
